title: Add optional customer search filters
pr_body: Supports status, date, and sort choices in the admin customer search.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

traps.rationale: The joined clauses are fixed SQL fragments defined in this function; user values remain parameters.
The sort key is checked against a fixed column allowlist before interpolation.
Tenant, status, and date values are bound parameters, not SQL text.
